item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Retry only unresolved attachments","mechanism":"Track each file independently; receiving a stable receipt makes acceptance sticky despite subsequent connection errors.","implementation":"Show uploading, accepted, failed, or unconfirmed rows. Exclude accepted rows from retry. Reconcile unconfirmed uploads through receipt status before offering another upload.","check":"Interrupt a five-file batch after two receipts arrive. Retrying must send neither accepted file and must clearly identify unresolved rows.","risk":"Without receipt reconciliation, a lost response remains unconfirmed."},{"action":"Restore receipts, not local file selections","mechanism":"Persist accepted-file references while explicitly distinguishing recoverable server attachments from unavailable browser selections.","implementation":"Keep only opaque receipts in local storage for 24 hours. On reopening, resolve their availability; explain that unaccepted files require reselection. Enforce expiry without storing file content.","check":"Close during partial success and reopen. Available accepted attachments return without uploading; missing selections and expired or unavailable receipts receive explicit explanations.","risk":"Receipt expiry enforcement needs reliable age information; shared-browser exposure requires consideration."},{"action":"Make the reviewed list the submission boundary","mechanism":"Separate attachment recovery from case creation; submit only an explicitly approved snapshot containing at most five accepted receipts.","implementation":"Provide remove and replace controls. Require unresolved rows to be resolved or explicitly omitted. Invalidate review after changes; disable repeated submission while pending.","check":"A sixth attachment, unresolved row, or post-review edit must block submission. Double-clicking Submit must issue one case-creation request.","risk":"Client gating alone cannot prevent duplicates after an ambiguous submission response."}],"abstention_reason":""}
